sentences.zh: 而且，珍娜，我不知道如果没有彼得和瓦尔坦，我们该怎么熬过孕期。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: They really fed us and nurtured us.
sentences.zh: 他们真的把我们喂得很好，也照顾得很好。

sentences.en: And, you know, I found a journal entry where I wrote about Peter and Vartan.
sentences.zh: 而且，我翻到了一篇日记，里面写到了彼得和瓦尔坦。

sentences.en: Oh, are you going to read it?
sentences.zh: 噢，你要读出来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm going to read it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我要读出来。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: It's just, it's a real short little entry, but it just speaks to how they took care of us.
sentences.zh: 这只是……这只是一条很短的记录，但它恰好说明了他们是如何照顾我们的。

sentences.en: So, at the top, it says July 21st, 2011, 4.02 p.m.
sentences.zh: 在最上面写着：2011年7月21日下午4点02分。

sentences.en: You know, I always say what time it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我总是会记下时间。

sentences.en: And I wrote, I had the day off from work today, but I had to go in for a wardrobe fitting.
sentences.zh: 我写道：今天我不用上班，但我得去参加服装试装。

sentences.en: I brought Isabel with me.
sentences.zh: 我带上了伊莎贝尔。

sentences.en: After my fitting, we had lunch on set, and Peter and Vartan were so sweet.
sentences.zh: 试装结束后，我们在片场吃了午饭，彼得和瓦尔坦人真的太好了。

sentences.en: They brought Isabel a special snack, cupcakes, and a smoothie.
sentences.zh: 他们给伊莎贝尔准备了特别的零食、纸杯蛋糕和冰沙。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: We had such a fun day.
sentences.zh: 我们度过了非常愉快的一天。

sentences.en: I love that, lady.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Isn't that so cute?
sentences.zh: 这不是很可爱吗？

sentences.en: Well, lady, I don't think there is anyone on our set who loved our food more than BJ Novak.
sentences.zh: 嗯，亲爱的，我觉得在我们片场，没有谁比BJ·诺瓦克更爱我们的食物了。

sentences.en: BJ is like a foodie.
sentences.zh: BJ是个美食家。

sentences.en: Like, for real, he's a foodie.
sentences.zh: 真的，他是那种真正的美食家。

sentences.en: He has a whole business now called Eat-A-Chain.
sentences.zh: 他现在有个完整的生意，叫“Eat-A-Chain”。

sentences.en: I know, right?
sentences.zh: 可不是吗？

sentences.en: And it's like Michelin star chefs turn your fast food favorites into, like, these elevated meals.
sentences.zh: 就像是米其林星级厨师把你最爱的快餐变成那种高级料理一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they're delicious.
sentences.zh: 而且非常美味。

sentences.en: I went to the Chili's one.
sentences.zh: 我去过那个 Chili's 的主题活动。

sentences.en: I've been to two now.
sentences.zh: 我现在已经去过两次了。

sentences.en: One I took the kids with.
sentences.zh: 有一次我带了孩子们一起去。

sentences.en: They had a pop-up of all these different types of food chains.
sentences.zh: 他们搞了一个快闪店，汇集了各种不同类型的连锁餐饮。

sentences.en: Delicious.
sentences.zh: 太美味了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, he invited our catering craft service teams to be on the DVD commentary track for season five,
sentences.zh: 他曾邀请我们的餐饮和后勤服务团队参加第五季的DVD评论音轨录制，

sentences.en: Business Ethics.
sentences.zh: 就是《商业道德》那一集。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: So I reached out to him.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了他。

sentences.en: And lady, I don't know if he's ever responded to me faster.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，我不知道他有没有哪次回复我比这次更快的。

sentences.en: He is so excited about food.
sentences.zh: 他对食物真是太兴奋了。

sentences.en: I remember when I came across that commentary years ago and I texted him.
sentences.zh: 我记得多年前我偶然发现那段评论时，还给他发了短信。

sentences.en: He was like, no way.
sentences.zh: 他当时说：不会吧。

sentences.en: Where can I find it?
sentences.zh: 我在哪能找到它？

sentences.en: He was so excited that it still lives somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他非常激动，没想到那段内容居然还留存在某个地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, he sent in an audio clip.
sentences.zh: 他发来了一段音频。

sentences.en: He has some advice for people who might be new to a set.
sentences.zh: 他给那些刚进片场的新人提了一些建议。

sentences.en: Oh, I can't wait to hear this.
sentences.zh: 噢，我迫不及待想听听了。

sentences.en: How to get the best stuff.
sentences.zh: 关于如何搞到最好的东西。

sentences.en: If I have any advice in show business, I have one piece of advice that I'm 100% sure of that I tell everyone, which is that if you want coffee on a set, get it from craft services,
sentences.zh: 如果我在演艺圈有什么建议的话，我有一条百分之百确定的建议要告诉所有人，那就是如果你想在片场喝咖啡，一定要去后勤服务台拿，

sentences.en: not catering.
sentences.zh: 不要去餐饮车拿。

sentences.en: When you arrive in the morning, there's going to be a truck that has all types of great food and they're going to have coffee on that truck.
sentences.zh: 当你早上到达时，会有一辆卡车提供各种很棒的食物，那辆车上也会有咖啡。

sentences.en: Do not get the coffee from the truck because they make coffee as an afterthought.
sentences.zh: 千万别喝那辆车上的咖啡，因为他们做咖啡只是顺带的。

sentences.en: Then there's craft services, which makes snacks and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后是后勤服务台，他们负责提供零食之类的东西。

sentences.en: But coffee is what they do.
sentences.zh: 但咖啡才是他们的主业。

sentences.en: That's what they're judged on.
sentences.zh: 那是衡量他们工作好坏的标准。

sentences.en: Go the extra 20 feet.
sentences.zh: 多走那20英尺吧。

sentences.en: Get your coffee from craft services, not catering.
sentences.zh: 去茶水间拿咖啡，别去餐饮部拿。

sentences.en: Catering is great, but coffee is not their thing.
sentences.zh: 餐饮部很棒，但咖啡不是他们的强项。

sentences.en: It's not their focus, nor should it be.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们的重点，也不该是。

sentences.en: Hashes in his voice.
sentences.zh: 他说话带点沙哑。

sentences.en: Like he is literally telling people where to get coffee on a set the way I beg people to go get their cancer screenings.
sentences.zh: 他就像在片场叮嘱大家去哪儿喝咖啡一样，就像我求大家去做癌症筛查那样。

sentences.en: It cracked me up.
sentences.zh: 这把我逗乐了。

sentences.en: The absolute like seriousness.
sentences.zh: 那种绝对的严肃感。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's right.
sentences.zh: 而且他是对的。

sentences.en: He is right.
sentences.zh: 他是对的。

sentences.en: I don't drink coffee, as you know, but I know craft services, they are sort of connoisseurs of like beverages and they do smoothies.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我不喝咖啡，但我知道茶水间的人，他们算是饮料方面的行家，还会做冰沙。

sentences.en: They do coffee.
sentences.zh: 他们负责咖啡。

sentences.en: They do hot cocoa.
sentences.zh: 他们负责热可可。

sentences.en: I mean, they have a gazillion types of teas.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们有成千上万种茶。

sentences.en: Like they are where you go for beverage.
sentences.zh: 他们就是你找饮料该去的地方。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He also talked a little bit about the food in the writer's room, which is not provided by craft services or catering.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到了一点编剧室的食物，那不是由茶水间或餐饮部提供的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: They have their own writer's assistant who has to manage food for the writers.
sentences.zh: 他们有自己的编剧助理，负责管理编剧们的伙食。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is because their hours would sometimes, they didn't coordinate with our hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是因为他们的工作时间有时和我们的对不上。

sentences.en: Like they would be there writing until like 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 他们有时会写到晚上10点。

sentences.en: or midnight.
sentences.zh: 或者午夜。

sentences.en: And then they also don't come in till 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有时要到上午10点才来。

sentences.en: sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时是这样。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they kind of had their whole own food situation.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有自己的一套饮食安排。

sentences.en: And here's what he had to say about that.
sentences.zh: 以下是他对此的看法。

sentences.en: Snacks are it's like when you're a babysitter.
sentences.zh: 零食就像你当保姆的时候一样。

sentences.en: It's all about what the people's cabinets have, what snacks they have.
sentences.zh: 全看雇主橱柜里有什么，有什么零食。

sentences.en: And same for a writer's room.
sentences.zh: 编剧室也一样。

sentences.en: It's what snacks are there.
sentences.zh: 全看那儿有什么零食。

sentences.en: And we went through periods where we had every snack in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们经历过拥有世上所有零食的时期。

sentences.en: It was turkey jerky from Trader Joe's was the favorite snack.
sentences.zh: Trader Joe's的火鸡肉干是最受欢迎的零食。

sentences.en: But it was all of these terribly salty Trader Joe's snacks.
sentences.zh: 但全是那些咸得要命的Trader Joe's零食。

sentences.en: And then every now and then we get disgusted with ourselves.
sentences.zh: 然后每隔一段时间，我们就会对自己感到厌恶。

sentences.en: We'd gain a lot of weight and we would ban all unhealthy foods from the writer's room and put them in the fridge and freezer by set.
sentences.zh: 我们会胖很多，然后禁止所有不健康的食物进入编剧室，把它们放进片场的冰箱和冷冻柜里。

sentences.en: So you could get an ice cream cone, but you had to walk to the freezer in the other trailer.
sentences.zh: 所以你想吃冰淇淋甜筒的话，就得走到另一辆拖车的冷冻柜那儿去。

sentences.en: And then we would slip.
sentences.zh: 然后我们又会破戒。

sentences.en: It would just be a cycle.
sentences.zh: 这简直是个循环。

sentences.en: So this is exactly how I remember the writer's room snacks, too, because I remember they had this back stairwell that went up to their kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我对编剧室零食的记忆也是这样，因为我记得他们有个通往厨房的后楼梯。

sentences.en: And sometimes we went up that way and it would be either feast or famine in there.
sentences.zh: 有时我们从那儿上去，里面要么是盛宴，要么是饥荒。

sentences.en: It would either be like seriously every type of like little Debbie cupcake or whatever to then just like nothing.
sentences.zh: 要么是各种各样的Little Debbie纸杯蛋糕之类的，要么就什么都没有。

sentences.en: Nothing are just like a rice cake.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有，或者只有米饼。

sentences.en: Yes, they did go through a whole like rice cake phase.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们确实经历过一阵子米饼热潮。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And then when they were going through that phase, that's when they got like a treadmill, remember?
sentences.zh: 然后当他们经历那个阶段时，他们还弄了台跑步机，记得吗？

sentences.en: But yeah, there was a real yo-yo effect with their snacks.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们的零食确实有种溜溜球效应。

sentences.en: Well, you know, our first AD, Kelly Cantley, I was texting with her and I said,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们的第一副导演Kelly Cantley，我当时在给她发短信，我说，

sentences.en: Hey, we're going to talk to Sergio for this food episode.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们要和Sergio聊聊这期食物主题的节目。

sentences.en: I'm curious, like, what's your breakfast order?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你的早餐通常点什么？

sentences.en: Well, lady, she gave me the scoop on her breakfast order and also Sergio's doing something new.
sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，她跟我透露了她的早餐点餐习惯，而且Sergio最近在搞些新花样。

sentences.en: She said that on the office, her breakfast order was either a baby burrito with bacon and no salsa or one scrambled egg with a side of black beans and avocado.
sentences.zh: 她说在《办公室》剧组时，她的早餐要么是一个培根小卷饼，不要莎莎酱，要么是一个炒蛋配黑豆和牛油果。

sentences.en: Black beans and avocado, it's big on our set.
sentences.zh: 黑豆配牛油果，在我们片场很流行。

sentences.en: But she said on the paper, Sergio has updated all the things that she likes and now serves breakfast as a mini taco.
sentences.zh: 但她说在《办公室》的时候，Sergio更新了所有她喜欢的餐点，现在早餐做成了迷你塔可。

sentences.en: I mean.
sentences.zh: 我是说。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He takes one tater tot and he smashes it in the bottom of each mini taco and then he'll put whatever your breakfast order is inside.
sentences.zh: 他拿一个炸薯球，把它压扁铺在每个迷你塔可的底部，然后把你的早餐配料放进去。

sentences.en: She said, it's genius.
sentences.zh: 她说，这简直是天才之举。

sentences.en: Sign me up.
sentences.zh: 算我一个。

sentences.en: You had me at smash tater tot.
sentences.zh: 听到“压扁炸薯球”我就被征服了。

sentences.en: She said if he had a taco stand or a restaurant, I would go every day.
sentences.zh: 她说如果他开了塔可摊或者餐厅，她每天都会去光顾。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That sounds so good.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I was trading texts with Sergio about being on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我之前和Sergio互发短信，聊到让他上播客的事。

sentences.en: Talk about someone who responded right away with such enthusiasm, much like BJ.
sentences.zh: 说起回复速度，他跟BJ一样，特别积极热情。

sentences.en: He could not wait to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他迫不及待地想和我们聊天。

sentences.en: He's such a lovely person and we had so much fun going down memory lane with him.
sentences.zh: 他是个非常可爱的人，我们和他一起回忆往事，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: We Zoomed with him the other day and we can't wait for you to hear our chat with him.
sentences.zh: 我们前几天和他进行了视频通话，迫不及待想让你们听听我们的谈话。

sentences.en: So here is our chat with Sergio.
sentences.zh: 那么，这就是我们与Sergio的对话。

sentences.en: Hello, Sergio.
sentences.zh: 你好，Sergio。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Louise.
sentences.zh: 你好，Louise。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来参加我们的播客。

sentences.en: I love the podcast, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我很喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: You all have nice voices, so it's soothing to the ear.
sentences.zh: 你们的声音都很好听，听起来很悦耳。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's funny and it's a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这节目很有趣，也很好玩。

sentences.en: Aw, thanks, Sergio.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你，Sergio。

sentences.en: It was so nice seeing you when we visited the paper.
sentences.zh: 我们去《办公室》片场探班时见到你真是太好了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那样。

sentences.en: That was such a surprise.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: We were slammed for breakfast, but it was nice seeing you guys.
sentences.zh: 当时我们早餐时间忙得不可开交，但能见到你们真好。

sentences.en: And also being on that show, you know, kind of like, you know, having some of the crew members from the office and, you know, Oscar.
sentences.zh: 还有能上那个节目，你知道，就像是和《办公室》的一些剧组成员，还有Oscar一起。

sentences.en: It was awesome doing that show, too.
sentences.zh: 能做那个节目也很棒。

sentences.en: It just brings a lot of memories.
sentences.zh: 它勾起了很多回忆。

sentences.en: Of what we had in the office, you know?
sentences.zh: 关于我们在《办公室》时的点滴，你懂的？

sentences.en: Well, Sergio, you are so loved.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Sergio，大家都很爱你。

sentences.en: I have noticed pretty much every time I'm on a set where Mindy's running the show, you're there.
sentences.zh: 我注意到几乎每次我在Mindy负责的剧组时，你都在那儿。

sentences.en: Like, the office family loves you and they always want to work with you.
sentences.zh: 就像《办公室》大家庭都很爱你，总是想和你一起工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，不，我很感激。

sentences.en: It's been amazing being part of the office, you know, because we had a lot of great times, right?
sentences.zh: 能成为《办公室》的一员真是太棒了，你知道，因为我们有过很多美好的时光，对吧？

sentences.en: It was such an amazing time.
sentences.zh: 那真是一段美妙的时光。

sentences.en: And for me as a cook and cooking for y'all, it was special.
sentences.zh: 对我这个厨师来说，能为你们做饭，感觉很特别。

sentences.en: You know, you mentioned breakfast and Kelly shared with us that you have started doing mini tacos for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你提到了早餐，Kelly跟我们分享说你开始做迷你塔可当早餐了。

sentences.en: She said you took her breakfast order and put it in a tiny taco and she said she can't get enough of it.
sentences.zh: 她说你把她的早餐点餐做成了迷你塔可，她说她怎么吃都吃不够。

sentences.en: Yeah, Kelly, it was awesome working with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 是啊，Kelly，和Kelly一起工作太棒了。

sentences.en: And yeah, she has like little orders, small orders, kind of like Angela.
sentences.zh: 而且，她点的餐都很小份，有点像Angela。

sentences.en: When Angela used to order her little Angela size.
sentences.zh: 以前Angela总是点她那种“Angela分量”的小份餐。

sentences.en: Yeah, Angie size.
sentences.zh: 没错，安吉的尺寸。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was fun.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那很有趣。

sentences.en: So, Sergio, you have been in this food business for so long.
sentences.zh: 那么，塞尔吉奥，你从事餐饮业已经这么久了。

sentences.en: How do you keep coming up with new ideas and new recipes?
sentences.zh: 你是如何不断想出新点子和新食谱的呢？

sentences.en: We're so curious how you put a menu together for the week.
sentences.zh: 我们很好奇你是如何安排每周菜单的。

sentences.en: Well, when I started the office, it was hard because there was no iPhone, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我刚开始做这一行时很困难，因为那时候还没有iPhone，对吧？

sentences.en: And I had to go through the cookbooks, you know, and just get the ideas from there.
sentences.zh: 我得翻阅各种食谱，你知道的，从里面找灵感。

sentences.en: And the feedback from the crew, that's kind of what you work with.
sentences.zh: 还有来自剧组的反馈，这基本上就是你工作的依据。

sentences.en: Like, oh, they like this.
sentences.zh: 比如，哦，他们喜欢这个。

sentences.en: So, you know, we're going that direction.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们就往那个方向做。

sentences.en: But yeah, it got easier when the iPhone came around, you know.
sentences.zh: 但确实，有了iPhone之后就容易多了，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it was just a lot easier.
sentences.zh: 所以真的轻松了很多。

sentences.en: But yeah, it was through crew members, what they like and all that.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实主要是通过剧组成员，看他们喜欢什么之类的。

sentences.en: So I have to ask you, you know, you're using word of mouth about what's a hit, what's not.
sentences.zh: 所以我得问问你，你是通过口碑来判断什么受欢迎，什么不受欢迎吗？

sentences.en: Was there a recipe you ever did that people were like, don't do that one again?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪道菜是你做过之后，大家说“别再做那道了”的？

sentences.en: Or was there one where everyone was like, you have to do that one again?
sentences.zh: 或者有没有哪道菜是大家说“你一定要再做一次”的？

sentences.en: Like, what are your hits and your misses?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你有哪些成功之作和失败之作？

sentences.en: They never really tell you like, oh, that wasn't good.
sentences.zh: 他们其实从来不会直接说“哦，那道菜不好吃”。

sentences.en: You know, I only got that once.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只遇到过一次这种情况。

sentences.en: And that was the Teamsters in New York, you know, one time.
sentences.zh: 那是纽约的卡车司机工会，你知道的，就那一次。

sentences.en: But only like as a family, like they already liked me a lot.
sentences.zh: 但那就像家人一样，因为他们本来就很喜欢我。

sentences.en: And they told me, hey, we love you.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说，嘿，我们很喜欢你。

sentences.en: But that last meal, you know, that's the only time they told me.
sentences.zh: 但那顿饭，你知道，那是他们唯一一次那样说。

sentences.en: But it was the Teamsters in New York, you know.
sentences.zh: 不过那是纽约的卡车司机工会，你知道的。

sentences.en: But other than that, with the office and all that, everybody was so nice.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，在办公室和其他地方，每个人都非常友善。

sentences.en: It was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那感觉真好。

sentences.en: Well, your food is amazing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你的厨艺太棒了。

sentences.en: That's why I couldn't believe anyone would ever tell you this was a miss.
sentences.zh: 所以我真不敢相信会有人跟你说那是失败之作。

sentences.en: But, you know, Jenna and I both had so many meals that we loved.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，珍娜和我都有很多非常喜欢的餐点。

sentences.en: What was your most requested meal?
sentences.zh: 你被点餐次数最多的是哪道菜？

sentences.en: The most requested meal?
sentences.zh: 被点餐次数最多？

sentences.en: It's the action stations, you know, like the pasta bars, the taco bars.
sentences.zh: 是现场制作台，你知道的，比如意面吧、塔可吧。

sentences.en: The crew always loved that, the action stations.
sentences.zh: 剧组总是很喜欢那个，现场制作台。

sentences.en: So every time we had like a fun station and, you know, especially the pasta bar and the taco bar, those are always a hit.
sentences.zh: 所以每次我们有那种有趣的餐台，你知道，尤其是意面吧和塔可吧，总是大受欢迎。

sentences.en: Well, I remember your pasta bar.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得你的意面吧。

sentences.en: I was a fan.
sentences.zh: 我是它的粉丝。

sentences.en: And you would have like all the different pastas and all the different ingredients and then different sauces.
sentences.zh: 你会准备各种不同的意面、各种配料，还有不同的酱汁。

sentences.en: And it was kind of like an omelet bar.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像煎蛋卷吧一样。

sentences.en: You just walk up and point to all the things you wanted and you guys would make it right there on the spot.
sentences.zh: 你走过去指着你想要的所有东西，你们就会当场做好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was so great.
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: It was fun.
sentences.zh: 很有趣。

sentences.en: I tried and have it.
sentences.zh: 我试着去吃过。

sentences.en: So when like also when Isabella, when she was young, she used to just eat plain pasta, right?
sentences.zh: 还有，当伊莎贝拉还小的时候，她总是只吃清淡的意面，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That was her go-to.
sentences.zh: 那是她的首选。

sentences.en: So, you know, it reminds me of that too, when Isabella was young coming to set.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这让我想起了伊莎贝拉小时候来片场的情景。

sentences.en: You were so sweet with her.
sentences.zh: 你对她真是太贴心了。

sentences.en: You would always set aside a little buttered noodles dish for her.
sentences.zh: 你总是会特意为她留一份黄油拌面。

sentences.en: You took such good care of all of us in that way.
sentences.zh: 你一直以来都那样无微不至地照顾我们所有人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, we grew into a family there and there's nothing like that, you know, ever going to happen again.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在那儿处成了一家人，那种感觉，你知道，再也不会有了。

sentences.en: I don't think once in a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这辈子也就这一次了。

sentences.en: Another thing, Sergio, is that you were able to like make a meal that was good for the people who were dairy-free and gluten-free and vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事，塞尔吉奥，你总能做出既适合不吃乳制品的人，又适合不吃麸质的人，还适合素食者吃的美味餐点。

sentences.en: And you would have a meat option, but then you would have also a fish option.
sentences.zh: 你既有肉类选择，也有鱼类选择。

sentences.en: How do you do it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: And also at breakfast, I never heard anybody order breakfast and you didn't have whatever the thing was.
sentences.zh: 而且早餐也是，我从来没听过有人点的早餐是你没准备好的。

sentences.en: Like, this is a silly question, but where do you keep all this food and who does the grocery shopping?
sentences.zh: 这问题听起来有点傻，但你把这些食物都存哪儿了？谁负责去买菜？

sentences.en: How do you do this?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么搞定这一切的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, so when, when it started, you know, season one, um, the mise en place for breakfast was a little bit small, but as the show grew in the, into the years, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，当第一季刚开始的时候，嗯，早餐的备料台还有点小，但随着节目一年年做下去，你知道，

sentences.en: like by the third season, you know, same crew members, the caSt.
sentences.zh: 到了第三季，你知道，还是那帮剧组成员和演员。

sentences.en: And, and so everybody had their little, you know, little specialty.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的一点，你知道，一点小偏好。

sentences.en: So I had to make sure I had this, I had to make sure I had goat cheese because a couple of orders, you know, and it grew the mise en place for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我得确保我有这个，我得确保我有山羊奶酪，因为有几个人点过，你知道，早餐的备料台就这么扩大了。

sentences.en: It grew like more and more as the years went on, but by the ninth season, I had a lot of stuff in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 随着年头增加，它越来越大，到第九季的时候，冰箱里已经塞满了东西。

sentences.en: But I bet, I bet you did.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，我敢说你肯定做了不少。

sentences.en: I mean, I feel like there were people who were like, I want my breakfast order, but will you throw some like hot peppers on it today?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得有些人会说，我想吃我点的早餐，但你今天能往里面加点辣椒吗？

sentences.en: And you'd say, sure.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会说，没问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错，是啊。

sentences.en: Especially I had, I had the Rashida special.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我还有那个“拉什达特供”。

sentences.en: That one was a hit, right?
sentences.zh: 那个很受欢迎，对吧？

sentences.en: Remember the Rashida special?
sentences.zh: 还记得“拉什达特供”吗？

sentences.en: That one was such a hit.
sentences.zh: 那个真的太受欢迎了。

sentences.en: So I had to have black beans.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须准备黑豆。

sentences.en: I had to have, you know, turkey bacon every day, every day, you know, that because corn tortillas, the green salsa, you know.
sentences.zh: 我必须准备，你知道，火鸡培根，每天都要，每天，你知道，还有玉米饼、绿莎莎酱，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that one really took off.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那个真的火了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it took off.
sentences.zh: 是啊，火起来了。

sentences.en: That took off for a while too.
sentences.zh: 那个也火了一阵子。

sentences.en: But, you know, Sergio, I was so curious.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，塞尔吉奥，我一直很好奇。

sentences.en: I've always wanted to ask you this.
sentences.zh: 我一直想问你这个。

sentences.en: How did you start as a chef?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么开始当厨师的？

sentences.en: What was your journey to doing this?
sentences.zh: 你走上这条路的过程是怎样的？

sentences.en: So I started, you know, this catering company as a dishwasher at 18.
sentences.zh: 我是在18岁时从洗碗工开始接触这家餐饮公司的。

sentences.en: And then I moved up, moved up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 然后我一步步晋升。

sentences.en: And then they gave me a shot, the catering company I was at.
sentences.zh: 后来他们给了我一个机会，就是我待的那家餐饮公司。

sentences.en: They gave me a shot as a chef, kind of young, like at 24.
sentences.zh: 他们给了我一个当厨师的机会，那时我还挺年轻的，大概24岁。

sentences.en: And I was like chef in commercials.
sentences.zh: 我当时是拍广告的厨师。

sentences.en: That's all I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我做的就只有这些。

sentences.en: So I had like five day recipes.
sentences.zh: 所以我只需要准备五天的食谱。

sentences.en: That's all I needed for commercials.
sentences.zh: 拍广告只需要这些。

sentences.en: And so then I got the call to do the office.
sentences.zh: 后来我接到了电话去负责《办公室》剧组。

sentences.en: So the office was my first show and like full on five days a week, months, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以《办公室》是我参与的第一个节目，那种全职的、一周五天、持续好几个月的，你知道。

sentences.en: So I was real nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时真的很紧张。

sentences.en: Like I was nervous on the first day.
sentences.zh: 第一天的时候我特别紧张。

sentences.en: And then the second day, the craft service, then it was another craft.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天，那个茶点服务员，那是另一个茶点服务员。

sentences.en: It wasn't it wasn't Peter and Rotten.
sentences.zh: 不是彼得和罗滕。

sentences.en: But that craft service told me on the second day, it said they were talking about you.
sentences.zh: 但那个茶点服务员第二天跟我说，他说大家都在谈论你。

sentences.en: And I was like real horrified that they were like something.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的吓坏了，以为他们说了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it was good news, right?
sentences.zh: 是啊，而且是好消息，对吧？

sentences.en: He says they were talking good about your food.
sentences.zh: 他说他们对你的厨艺评价很高。

sentences.en: And that gave me the confidence to try hard and all that.
sentences.zh: 这让我有了信心去努力尝试之类的。

sentences.en: And it was such a nice crew that it was easy to do.
sentences.zh: 而且剧组氛围很好，做起来也很轻松。

sentences.en: But I learned a lot through the office, you know, through the casting crew.
sentences.zh: 但我通过办公室，你知道，通过选角团队学到了很多。

sentences.en: I learned a lot like, you know, like through the cooking and took it, took it with me to the other shows.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多，比如通过烹饪，然后我把这些经验带到了其他节目中。

sentences.en: But yeah, the office was my school.
sentences.zh: 但确实，办公室就是我的学校。

sentences.en: How much did you coordinate with Michael and Vartan?
sentences.zh: 你和迈克尔还有瓦尔坦协调得怎么样？

sentences.en: Because they would bring out like a certain hot snack every day at 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 因为他们每天十点都会带出某种热乎的小吃。

sentences.en: And did you guys talk?
sentences.zh: 你们会沟通吗？

sentences.en: Like, were you sure to be like, OK, if they're doing a hot dog bar, I'm not going to do hot dogs at lunch?
sentences.zh: 比如，你会确认一下，比如，好吧，如果他们要做热狗吧，我就不在午餐做热狗了吗？

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实会。

sentences.en: We tried.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试过。

sentences.en: But for some reason, we still always ended up doing the same thing, you know, kind of, you know, like, oh, you're doing that?
sentences.zh: 但不知为何，我们最后总是会做一样的东西，你知道，就是那种，噢，你们在做那个？

sentences.en: So, but yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，确实是这样。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so funny.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I don't have that memory at all.
sentences.zh: 我完全没有那种记忆。

sentences.en: I was like, somehow you guys never managed to double up in my mind.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得，不知怎么的，你们在我印象中从来没撞过菜。

sentences.en: OK, that's good.
sentences.zh: 好的，那很好。

sentences.en: Because, yeah, Peter and Vartan, you know, like we come up with something.
sentences.zh: 因为，彼得和瓦尔坦，你知道，我们想出点什么。

sentences.en: I'm doing that today.
sentences.zh: 我今天就做那个。

sentences.en: But yeah, they were so much fun, those two guys, man.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，那两个家伙太有趣了，伙计。

sentences.en: I loved them.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢他们。

sentences.en: And I miss them.
sentences.zh: 我很想念他们。

sentences.en: Yeah, same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: You know, Sergio, I'm so curious, too, because you are planning meals all the time and huge meals, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道，塞尔吉奥，我也很好奇，因为你一直在规划餐食，而且还是大餐。

sentences.en: Do you plan any meals at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家会规划餐食吗？

sentences.en: Are you just like once you're home, you are done meal planning?
sentences.zh: 还是说一旦回到家，你就彻底不想规划餐食了？

sentences.en: No, I am.
sentences.zh: 不，我会的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我会规划。

sentences.en: I actually cook for my boys on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 周末我其实会为我的孩子们做饭。

sentences.en: I see them on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我周末会见到他们。

sentences.en: So we do every weekend.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每个周末都会一起。

sentences.en: We I do a dinner and we watch movies.
sentences.zh: 我会做顿晚餐，然后我们一起看电影。

sentences.en: And I like to cook here, too.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢在这里做饭。

sentences.en: It's a lot funner and, you know, get to experience new stuff.
sentences.zh: 这更有趣，而且，你知道，可以尝试新东西。

sentences.en: I like cooking at home.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在家里做饭。

sentences.en: It's that when I'm working.
sentences.zh: 只是在我工作的时候。

sentences.en: If I'm working, then, you know, only that Saturday is the only day I'll cook.
sentences.zh: 如果我在工作，那么，你知道，只有周六是我会做饭的日子。

sentences.en: Oh, that's fair.
sentences.zh: 噢，那很公平。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I love your food so much that when I worked on the office,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我太喜欢你的食物了，以至于我在《办公室》工作时，

sentences.en: I would go through the lunch line and I would pick something for lunch and then I would wait for everybody to eat.
sentences.zh: 我会去午餐排队，挑点午餐吃，然后等大家都吃完。

sentences.en: And then as you all would start to kind of pack up stuff, like lunch was over, I would go through and I would get one of your to go containers and I would pick something.
sentences.zh: 然后当你们开始收拾东西，午餐结束时，我会再去拿一个外带盒，挑点东西。

sentences.en: And that's what I would eat for dinner.
sentences.zh: 那就是我晚餐要吃的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's nice.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那真不错。

sentences.en: So I would eat your food twice a day for all those years on the office.
sentences.zh: 所以在《办公室》的那几年里，我每天都吃两次你做的饭。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate that, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我很感激，珍娜。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah, there was many times we were taking food home.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们有很多次都把食物带回家了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: Sergio, do you have a favorite food memory from the office or a behind the scenes memory?
sentences.zh: 塞尔吉奥，你在《办公室》剧组里有没有什么关于食物的难忘回忆，或者幕后的趣事？

sentences.en: It doesn't have to be food related just from your time on the show.
sentences.zh: 不一定非得是关于食物的，只要是你在剧组期间的经历就行。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's my most memorable one.
sentences.zh: 有，那是我最难忘的一件事。

sentences.en: It was kind of a sad one, but it was Steve Carell's last day and we went to the warehouse and we did that beautiful speech.
sentences.zh: 虽然有点伤感，但那是史蒂夫·卡瑞尔在剧组的最后一天，我们去了仓库，发表了那段感人的演讲。

sentences.en: And then we took the time to talk to every department, you know, and I'll never forget it.
sentences.zh: 然后我们花时间与每个部门的人交谈，你知道，我永远不会忘记那一刻。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, there wasn't a dry eye in the room.
sentences.zh: 当时，你知道，屋子里没有一个人不流泪的。

sentences.en: Everybody was, it was the most memorable one that I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 每个人都……那是我最难忘的经历，我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Have you run into Steve since the office wrapped?
sentences.zh: 《办公室》完结后，你见过史蒂夫吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 见过。

sentences.en: Yeah, so when Vartan passed away, I found out, you know, about it through Debbie and me, Alan, and Debbie went and we were right there at the funeral.
sentences.zh: 是的，瓦尔坦去世的时候，我是从黛比那里得知的，我和艾伦、黛比一起去了葬礼现场。

sentences.en: And then it was, you know, us three and in walks Steve Carell.
sentences.zh: 当时我们三个在那儿，然后史蒂夫·卡瑞尔走了进来。

sentences.en: And it was like, it was us four right there.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们四个人聚在了一起。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, that's a beautiful moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常美好的时刻。

sentences.en: And we got to, you know, talk with Steve Carell about the office.
sentences.zh: 我们还有机会和史蒂夫·卡瑞尔聊了聊《办公室》。

sentences.en: And that was the last time I saw him.
sentences.zh: 那是我最后一次见到他。

sentences.en: I also saw him on Space Force, but the last time was Vartan, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我也在《太空部队》里见过他，但最后一次见面应该是在瓦尔坦的葬礼上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I know several people have always asked us about the different menus on the show and what our favorite meal was.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人一直问我们关于剧组里不同的菜单，以及我们最喜欢的餐点是什么。

sentences.en: And, you know, Sergio, my favorite was anything with your salsa.

sentences.zh: 塞尔吉奥就会在那扇门外摆好摊位。

sentences.en: That's my favorite moment there at stage three, you know, it's just seeing everybody there.

sentences.zh: 那真的很棒。
